name: Uproot
description: Deadwood tears a tree from the ground, gaining bonus damage on his next 4 attacks. While holding a tree he can throw it at an enemy, dealing damage and applying a stun and tapering slow.

source.notes: From hon_reborn_slice.json. Self-cast grants State_Deadwood_Ability2 (permanent until charges gone). Sets charges=4. On final charge, auto-throws (Projectile_Deadwood_Ability2). Throw mode is a modifier[key=deadwood_ihasatree] on this same ability, range 650, cooldown 0.

adapted.adaptation_reason: Cooldown: ceil(15s / 5s) = 3 turns. Duration collapsed to 4 (charges). Self-cast applies the tree-holding buff for 4 attack charges. Throw action: costs no energy, no cooldown — available once tree is held. In card-game terms: this creates a 'holding tree' ActiveEffect with 4 charges; each attack burns a charge and adds bonus damage (15-60 per level). On last charge or as a free action: Throw at one enemy for Stun (1 turn, mini-stun = 0 turns → 1 minimum) + Slow effect.
